packageRules.description: Don't track our own published app image
Auto-merge all non-major updates once required checks pass; major bumps are reviewed manually
Group all patch updates into a single PR
Group all minor updates into a single PR
Group all GitHub Actions updates. Actions are digest-pinned, so pin and digest carry nearly all of them and must be matched alongside minor and patch
Group all OpenTelemetry packages. Regex, not a glob: a glob star does not cross the path separator, so otel** would miss every otel submodule
Group all AWS SDK packages. Regex for the same reason as opentelemetry above
Group base image updates, weekly Monday. Covers docker-compose as well as the Dockerfile, since the observability stack images live in compose

Update the go.mod go directive and the golang builder image together, so the pinned toolchain and the base image never drift into a build break. Placed after the generic groups: later rules win on groupName

Update the playwright npm client and the playwright sidecar image together. In managed mode they are two ends of one connection: a mismatch fails the handshake and breaks every browser check, so they must never be bumped separately. Placed last for the same ordering reason as go toolchain
